title: Studying Negative Health Impact of Sustained Exposure to Second-hand Smoke from Neighbouring HDB Units on Children and Elderly
what_it_is: Studying Negative Health Impact of Sustained Exposure to Second-hand Smoke from Neighbouring HDB Units on Children and Elderly

sections.label: Second-hand smoke guidelines and smoking bans
sections.summary: MOH previously addressed second-hand smoke health effects; no official guidelines are planned, and MSE and NEA have prohibited smoking at over 49,000 public places.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The health effects of prolonged exposure to second-hand smoke was previously addressed in the Ministry of Health's (MOH's) answer to oral Question No 12 during Parliamentary Sitting on 2 October 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: There are currently no plans to issue official guidelines on the negative health impact of second-hand smoke.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MSE and NEA have progressively prohibited smoking at more than 49,000 public places, including most common areas of residential buildings, such as common corridors and void decks, to reduce the public's exposure to second-hand smoke.

sections.label: Second-hand smoke health impact
sections.summary: The negative health impact of second-hand smoke is very well established.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The negative health impact of second-hand smoke is very well established.

sections.label: No guidelines but policies consider impact
sections.summary: There are no official guidelines and no plans to issue them, but the health impact is considered in policies, advisories, I Quit Programmes and health promotion.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Because the Member's question is not about us not doing anything about it; the question is about issuing guidelines.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And in respect of guidelines, while there are no official guidelines and there are no plans to issue official guidelines, we already take into consideration this health impact as we are rolling out policies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And our policies come in multiple forms, including how we issue advisories or how we support with the I Quit Programmes, how we also address these matters in our health promotion activities.

sections.label: Enforcement outside MOH remit
sections.summary: Translating and enforcing this in the spaces may not directly lie within MOH's remit.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Translating and enforcing it in the spaces may not directly lie within the purview of MOH's remit.
